vibe: Premium, minimal, clean, trust-first, high contrast with generous whitespace. Smooth mobile bottom-sheet modals for a native-like feel.

rules: Use Outfit for big balance numbers and headings.
Use Manrope for all transaction lists, labels, and small text.
Use tracking-tight on large numeric balances.

spacing_and_layout.general: Use p-4 to p-6 for standard mobile container padding. Avoid cramming elements.
spacing_and_layout.modals: Always use Bottom Sheets (Sheet component or tailored sliding divs) for mobile edit modals. Must use rounded-t-[32px] with a prominent top drag handle.
spacing_and_layout.buttons: rounded-full, h-14, text-base font-semibold. Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-300. Secondary: bg-gray-100 text-slate-900 hover:bg-gray-200.

wallet_card.style: A premium card inside the wallet subpage. Uses the abstract wave image as background, combined with a subtle white gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Text should be Slate-900.
wallet_card.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] border border-gray-200 shadow-md p-6 h-52 flex flex-col justify-between

transaction_list.style: Clean rows without individual card wrappers. Just a flex container with border-b on items.
transaction_list.classes: flex items-center justify-between py-4 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0

loyalty_tier.style: A premium status card indicating loyalty status. Subtle gold/bronze accents.
loyalty_tier.classes: bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-50 to-white border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 rounded-[24px] p-6 shadow-sm

edit_modal.style: Bottom sheet modal for quick actions (edit profile, withdraw, wallet settings).
edit_modal.classes: fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50 bg-white rounded-t-[32px] shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] pb-8 pt-4 px-6

icons.style: Thin stroke width (strokeWidth={1.5}) for a precise, elegant look.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle scale up (scale-[1.02]) on interactive cards.
motion_and_interactions.active_states: scale-[0.98] on buttons for tactile feedback.

image_urls.description: Premium white abstract wavy texture for the virtual wallet card background.

testing_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='edit-wallet-modal-button').
instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor the Wallet, Loyalty, and Affiliate pages to use this lighter, high-contrast, premium styling. Update all Edit Modals in these flows to be Bottom Sheets (rounded-t-[32px]) rather than centered popups to fit the mobile context. Ensure text and backgrounds follow the high-contrast luxury light theme. Apply generous padding and crisp 1px borders. Use the provided abstract wavy texture for the Wallet balance card.
